# Bay Area Office Systems

> Family-run Ricoh copier dealer serving San Francisco, the Peninsula, Oakland and the East Bay since 1995. We lease, rent, sell and service professionally refurbished Ricoh color multifunction copiers and printers for businesses, schools and nonprofits.

- Services: refurbished Ricoh copier leasing (most leases are 36 months), month-to-month and short-term rentals, refurbished copier sales, and service plans covering toner, parts, labor and repairs (per-page or flat monthly plans).
- Service: our own technician. Most service calls are handled the next business day.
- Machines: Ricoh color multifunction copiers that print, copy and scan, including letter, legal and 11x17, with optional stapling and hole punching, secure PIN printing and user codes. Every copier is also a network printer.
- Service area: San Francisco; the Peninsula from Daly City to Redwood City; Oakland, Berkeley, Emeryville, Alameda, San Leandro and Hayward; nearby South Bay case by case.
- Customers: schools, law firms, churches and nonprofits, accounting and professional offices.
- Pricing: quoted per customer based on monthly print volume and color use. To quote we need: city, pages per month, color or black and white, and timeline. Quote form: https://www.bayareaofficesystems.com/index.html#contact
- Contact: info@bayareaofficesystems.com (preferred); phone (650) 992-2000. Hours Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.
